top_signals.title: Lockheed Martin unveils PAC-3 Edge interceptor designed to counter hypersonic threats
top_signals.summary: Lockheed Martin said PAC-3 Edge incorporates a new seeker, upgraded flight controls and a multi-pulse rocket motor supplied by Northrop Grumman.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
